paite: "TOUPA zahngaihna thute tangtawn in la in ka sa ding a; ka kam in na ginomdan suan tengteng tan in ka theisak ding.
heading: Ezrah Mi Ethan Lavui / Nam Mangbat Hun A La
english: A contemplation by Ethan, the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.

paite: Zahngaihna tangtawn a ding in leptouh in a-om ding a; na ginomna vante ah ngei na hihkip ding, ka chita ahi.
english: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”

paite: Ka mitel kiang ah thu ka khung a, ka sikha David kiang ah ka kichiamta a;
english: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,

paite: na suante tangtawn a ding in ka hihkip ding a, na laltutphah leng suan tengteng tan in ka lem ding, chi in. Selah
english: ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.

paite: "TOUPA aw, vante'n na thillamdang hihte aphat ding ua; misiangthoute kikhopna ah na ginomna leng aphat ding uhi.
english: The heavens will praise your wonders, Yahweh, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

paite: Tung vandumte ah TOUPA toh kiteh thei ding kua a-om a? Mihattak tate lak ah TOUPA bang.
english: For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like Yahweh,

paite: Misiangthoute omkhawmna ah Pathian kihtakhuaitak, akim a mi tengteng sang a kihtakpen ding kua ahia?
english: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?

paite: "TOUPA sepaihte' Pathian aw, nang bang a mihat kua a-om a? Na ginomna na kim ah a-om ngal a.
english: Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? Yah, your faithfulness is around you.

paite: Nang tuipi kisaktheihna vai na hawm a, atuikihot kiseplaite uh na hihdai hi.
english: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.

paite: Nang Rahab gal thah bang in na hihkham dimdem a; nangmah galte na ban thahat in na delhzakta hi.
english: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.

paite: Vante nangmah a ahi a, leitung leng nangmah a ahi; khovel leh asung a om teng nangmah muhkhiak ahi.
english: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.

paite: Sim leh mal nangmah siam ahi a; Tabor leh Hermon na min ziak in anuam hi.
english: You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.

paite: Nang ban thilhihtheitak na nei a; na khut ahat a, na khut taklam pahtawi in a-om hi.
english: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.

paite: "Diktatna leh vaihawmna dik na laltutphah kingakna ahi a; na ma ah zahngaihna leh thutak apai hi.
english: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.

paite: "Husa kipahhuai za namte'n nuam asa ua; TOUPA aw, amau na mel vak ah avak uhi.
english: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, Yahweh.

paite: Na min ziak in nitum in anuam ua, diktatna ziak in pahtawi in a-om uhi.
english: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.

paite: Nang ahatna uh thupina na hi ngal a; na deihsakna ziak in ka kii uh pahtawi in a-om ding.
english: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.

paite: Ka phaw uh TOUPA a ahi ngal a; ka kumpipa uh Israelte Mi Siangthou ahi.
english: For our shield belongs to Yahweh, our king to the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Huai lai in na misiangthoute kiang ah kilakna in thu na gen a, mihattak khat tung ah panpihna ka nga a; mi khat mite lak a telkhiak ka pahtawita hi, chi in.
heading: David kiang a Pathian Thuchiam
english: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.

paite: Ka sikha David ka mukheta a; ka thau siangthou in amah ka nilhta a.
english: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,

paite: Akiang ah ka khut hihkip in a-om ding a; ka ban in amah ahihhat ding a, ahihhat taktak ding hi.
english: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.

paite: "Melma in alak ah aphut kei ding; thulimlouhna tapa in ahihgim kei ding.
english: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.

paite: Amah galte ama ah ka satpuk ding a, amah hote ka bawl ek ding.
english: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.

paite: Amah kiang ah bel ka ginomna leh ka zahngaihna a-om ding hi; ka min ziak in akii pahtawi in a-om ding hi.
english: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.

paite: Tuipi ah akhut ka ngasak ding a, luipite ah akhut taklam.
english: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.

paite: Ama'n, 'Nang ka Pa, ka Pathian, ka hotdamna suangpi na hi,' chi in ahon sam ding hi.
english: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’

paite: Huan ke'n amah tapa masa in ka siam ding a, lei a kumpipate lak ah tungnungpen in ka bawl ding hi.
english: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

paite: Ka zahngaihna tangtawn in amah a ding in ka kephoihsak ding a, ka thukhun akiang ah a- omkip ding hi.
english: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.

paite: Asuante tangtawn in ka omsak ding a, alaltutphah van om lai siah in ka omsak ding hi.
english: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

paite: "Atate'n ka dan alehngatsan ua, ka vaihawmnate bang a a-om louh ua;
english: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;

paite: ka dan thuseh a tatlekna aneih ua, ka thupiakte akephoih kei uleh;
english: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;

paite: atatlek chiang un ka gawt dia, athulimlouhnate uh zep in ka hong kan ding.
english: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

paite: Himahleh, ka zahngaihna tu in akiang a kipan ka laksak vek kei ding a, ka ginomna zuau a suak ding in leng ka phal sam kei ding.
english: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.

paite: Ka thukhun ka hihse kei ding a, ka muk a thupawt leng ka hihlamdang sam kei ding hi.
english: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.

paite: "Khatvei ka sianthouna lou in ka kichiam a, David kiang ah zuau ka gen kei ding;
english: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.

paite: Asuante tangtawn in a-om ding ua, alaltutphah ka ma ah ni bang in a-om ding hi.
english: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.

paite: Kha bang in tangtawn a ding in hihkip in a-om ding a, van dum a theihpih ginom bang in, achi a. Selah
english: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.

paite: "Himahleh nang na khahkhia in na deih kei a, na thaunilhpa tung ah na hehta ahi.
english: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.

paite: Na sikha thukhun na deih kei a; alallukhu lei a paikhe hial in na hihniamta hi.
english: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.

paite: Ahuang tengteng na hihpuk a; akulhpite na hihseta hi.
english: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.

paite: Lampi a pai peuhmah in athil alaksak zel uh.
english: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.

paite: Amah doute khut taklam na pahtawi a; amelma tengteng na hih nuamsata hi.
english: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.

paite: Ahi, anamsau ma na bengpek a, amah kisualna ah na dingkipsak kei hi.
english: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.

paite: Avakna na hihtawpsak a, alaltutphah lei ah na paikheta hi.
english: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.

paite: Atangval lai nite uh na hihtom a; amah zahlakna in na khuhta hi. Selah
english: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.

paite: "TOUPA aw, bang tan ahia na buk nilouh ding? Bang tan ahia na hehna mei bang a akuan ding?
english: How long, Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?

paite: Aw, ka hun atomdan theigige inla; mihing tate siam gina kei na tel chia!
english: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!

paite: Kua mi ahia sih ni mel mu lou a hing a, Sheol khut a kipan a ahinna humbit ding? Selah
english: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.

paite: "TOUPA, nidanglai a na hehpihna, na ginomna David kiang a kichiam a na chiam, koi a om hita ahia?
english: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?

paite: TOUPA, na sikhate agensiatna uh theigige in; nam hattakte tengteng gensiatna ka angsung a ka thuak zeldan.
english: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,

paite: TOUPA aw, nang hon doute gensiatna, na thaunilhpa khapte gensiatna mah,
english: With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.

paite: TOUPA tangtawn in phat in om hen. Amen, Amen."
english: Blessed be Yahweh forever more. Amen, and Amen.
